news.title: Advance Reservations Open for the Jeju World Heritage Festival
threeLineSummary: Advance reservations for the Jeju festival’s main programs will begin.
The festival will be held from October 3 to 18.
Twenty-five international students participated in the Global Academy.
news.detailedSummary: The Jeju World Heritage Headquarters will begin accepting advance reservations for the main programs of the 2026 World Heritage Festival on Ticketlink at 10 a.m. on the 20th. The festival will be held in Jeju from October 3 to 18, and reservations are available for the walking tour, Special Exploration Team, Heritage Village Stories, Starlight Hiking and Sunrise Tour, and World Heritage Exploration Bus. Participation fees vary by program and are paid. Apart from the reservation method, the article does not provide specific details about eligibility or other participation requirements. Twenty-five international students from 24 countries, selected through a screening process, experienced Jeju’s World Heritage sites and created content during the two-night, three-day Global Academy.

news.title: Seodaemun-gu to Hold the 2026 Sinchon Global University Culture Festival
threeLineSummary: The festival will take place in Sinchon from September 11 to 13.
International students can participate in a sports day and a singing contest.
For the singing contest, participants must submit a video and application form by August 30.
news.detailedSummary: Hosted by Seodaemun-gu and co-organized by the university students’ central planning group, the festival will take place around Yonsei-ro in Sinchon from September 11 to 13, 2026. The “Sinchon SWYFT Sports Day,” involving 200 Korean university students and international students, will be held free of charge from 10 a.m. to noon on September 12, with participants accepted on a first-come, first-served basis. International students living in Korea can apply for the “International Student Singing Contest” individually or in teams of up to 10 people. They must submit a 1–2-minute singing video and an application form by August 30. Information about applications and program details can be found on the festival’s official website or in the notices section of the Seodaemun-gu Office website. For more information, contact the Culture and Sports Division of the Seodaemun-gu Office.

news.title: Namseoul University President Yoon Seung-yong Reappointed; 2,169 International Students
threeLineSummary: Namseoul University President Yoon Seung-yong will serve another term as the university’s 11th president.
The university has been recognized for its international competitiveness, with 2,169 international students enrolled.
The Department of AI Mobility is scheduled to be established starting in the second semester.
news.detailedSummary: The board of the Seongam Educational Foundation decided to reappoint President Yoon Seung-yong as Namseoul University’s 11th president, with his new term beginning on the 20th. Namseoul University currently has 2,169 international students enrolled, ranking 36th nationwide and third in the Chungcheong region according to the 2025 disclosure. Namseoul University has been selected as a certified university for educational internationalization capacity for four consecutive years. However, the article does not provide specific information about support for international students’ admission, stay, or foreigner registration. Starting in the second semester, the university plans to establish the Department of AI Mobility in cooperation with the AI Innovation Center and provide AI and digital convergence education for all students. However, the article does not provide specific information about the admission process or eligibility requirements.

news.title: Jeonju Expands Travel Opportunities for International Students and Other Foreign Residents
threeLineSummary: Jeonju is operating the 2026 Jeonju Duri Travel program.
International students living in Korea are also eligible to participate.
Participants will experience Jeonju’s history, culture, traditions, and food.
news.detailedSummary: Jeonju City and the Jeonju Tourism Foundation will operate the 2026 Jeonju Duri Travel program nine times through October. Participants were selected through an open application and screening process from among single-parent families, families with multiple children, children and teenagers at childcare facilities, foreign workers and international students, low-income people, and people with disabilities. Foreign workers and international students living in Korea will be offered a stay-based tourism program in Jeonju, where they can experience the city’s history, culture, traditions, and food. The article does not provide specific details about the application schedule, how to apply, or participation fees.
